meta.name: brand-landingpage
meta.description: Brand-first landing page designer — runs a brand-identity interview (colors, typography, shape language), then generates and iterates on a polished landing page via Stitch with deployment-ready HTML. Use when the user asks to create, design, or build a landing page, homepage, or marketing page and has no established visual direction. Skip when they have a design mockup, need a dashboard or app UI, are working at component level, building a multi-page app, or restyling with known design tokens — use frontend-design instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 进行品牌访谈,生成可直接部署的落地页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要一个有品牌调性的落地页但还没定视觉方向
copy.tagline_en: Run a brand interview and generate a deployable landing page.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a brand-oriented landing page but don't have a visual direction.

howto.what: Claude 会先问你产品、品牌感觉和视觉偏好等约10个问题,再把答案转成配色、字体、圆角等设计参数,调用 Stitch 生成桌面/移动版落地页 HTML;根据你的反馈修改或出变体,最后打包交付 HTML、设计文档和部署说明。
howto.when: 当你要创建、设计或构建落地页、首页或营销页,且还没有既定视觉方向时触发。已有设计稿、要做仪表盘或应用界面等场景会跳过。

say.text: 我给新产品做一个落地页,先按你的问题走一遍。
say.note: 启动品牌访谈,后续会生成页面。

say.text: 深色+圆角+现代字体,生成首页的第一个版本。
say.note: 按这个方向生成桌面版首稿。

say.text: 第一个版本不好看,出两三个不同风格让我对比。
say.note: 生成多个变体,方便选择方向。

howto.what_en: Runs a ~10-question brand interview, maps answers to design parameters, generates desktop/mobile landing-page HTML via Stitch, iterates on feedback, and delivers a bundle with HTML, design docs, and deploy notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create, design, or build a landing, home, or marketing page without an established visual direction.

say_en.text: I need a landing page for my product — walk me through your questions.
Dark mode, rounded corners, modern fonts. Generate the first desktop version.
The first draft isn't working. Show me a couple of different styles.
